subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should Antigravity Automatic mode continue honoring the existing “Prioritize exhausted quotas” preference after moving its primary lanes to Gemini session and weekly quotas?
rationale: The patch deliberately replaces a persisted user preference with unconditional exhausted-first behavior; source review can identify the compatibility break but cannot choose whether retiring that behavior is intended product direction.

options.title: Preserve the existing preference
options.body: Keep Gemini-only lane mapping, but gate exhausted-first Antigravity selection on the stored preference and retain regression coverage for both settings.

options.title: Retire the preference deliberately
options.body: Remove or migrate the setting with visible upgrade documentation and tests that establish unconditional exhausted-first behavior as the supported contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing preference
recommendation.body: Keep Gemini-only lane mapping, but gate exhausted-first Antigravity selection on the stored preference and retain regression coverage for both settings.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product direction is required to decide whether this existing preference remains part of the Antigravity contract.
